@graph.security_statusNotes: Palo Alto Networks advisory, updated 2026-10-28, lists fixed hotfix thresholds for each affected PAN-OS branch; some listed hotfixes still carry 2026-10-29/30 ETAs. The same thresholds apply to PA-Series, VM-Series and Panorama (virtual and M-Series); earlier builds remain affected. Scope is the management web interface (HTTPS web UI and XML API), and active exploitation has been observed against internet-exposed management interfaces.

Scope is the management web interface (HTTPS web UI and XML API), and active exploitation has been observed against internet-exposed management interfaces.
@graph.security_actionStatement: Upgrade PAN-OS and Panorama to an available fixed hotfix for the deployed branch, or to a later fixed release when the branch-specific hotfix becomes available. @graph.security_statusNotes: Affected when deployed on an affected web-serving PHP runtime; PHP upstream confirms this runtime scope and Calif confirmed representative application-level pre-auth RCE. The remediation is the PHP runtime upgrade.
@graph.summary: CVE-2026-109618 assessment: Affected when deployed on an affected web-serving PHP runtime; PHP upstream confirms this runtime scope and Calif confirmed representative application-level pre-auth RCE. The remediation is the PHP runtime upgrade.
@graph.comment: Primary research reviewed 2026-10-21. Calif confirms pre-auth RCE on WordPress 7.1.2, Drupal 11.4.3, Joomla 6.1.4, Magento 2.4.9, MediaWiki 1.46.2, Laravel 13.11, Symfony 8.1, phpMyAdmin 5.2.3, Roundcube 1.7.4 and WHMCS. The assessed element is the affected PHP runtime scope, not an application-code defect.
@graph.security_actionStatement: Upgrade the serving PHP runtime to 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35, or apply a vendor backport, then restart PHP workers; updating application code alone does not remediate this PHP flaw.

externalRef.comment: Calif primary research confirming representative application exploitation
PHP upstream remediation guidance for the assessed runtime

@graph.security_statusNotes: Affected when deployed on an affected web-serving PHP runtime; product evidence establishes a PHP web application, web interface, web service or HTTP framework scope, and the PHP defect is below the application layer.
@graph.summary: CVE-2026-109618 assessment: Affected when deployed on an affected web-serving PHP runtime; product evidence establishes a PHP web application, web interface, web service or HTTP framework scope, and the PHP defect is below the application layer.
@graph.comment: 0-Z inventory audit reviewed 2026-10-21. PHP upstream states all installations serving web requests are at risk; Wiz Research states exploitation is in PHP itself and can affect even a simple Hello World application. Each VEX product in this relationship already has product-specific evidence recorded on its package establishing a PHP web-serving scope. The assessed element is the affected PHP runtime scope, not an application-code defect.
@graph.security_actionStatement: Upgrade the serving PHP runtime to 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35, or apply a vendor backport, then restart PHP workers; updating application code alone does not remediate this PHP flaw.

externalRef.comment: PHP upstream remediation guidance for the assessed runtime
Wiz Research explains that exploitation is in PHP itself and can affect any PHP web application

@graph.security_statusNotes: QNAP QSA-26-18 lists these product versions as affected by both PHP2Shell CVEs; fixed versions are to be announced.
@graph.summary: CVE-2026-109618 assessment: QNAP QSA-26-18 lists these product versions as affected by both PHP2Shell CVEs; fixed versions are to be announced.
@graph.comment: Added from QNAP Security Advisory QSA-26-18 released 2026-10-22 and reviewed 2026-10-22. The advisory states that PHP is used in web components of QNAP operating systems and several QNAP applications, lists these product versions as affected, and says fixed versions will be published later. The QuMagie scope is taken from the advisory's explicit affected-products header; the rendered affected-products table on the same page omits a separate QuMagie row.
@graph.security_actionStatement: Keep affected devices off the internet where possible, disable direct exposure and unnecessary PHP-based services, use VPN and trusted-network restrictions, and apply QNAP fixes when released.
